A security update for two Python packages in the image.

## 🎨 Design

- The README no longer shows the in-development notice.

## ⚡ Improved

- **pyasn1 0.6.5 and dnspython 2.9.1.** The base image ships pyasn1 0.6.4, which has four open security advisories, and the image installs 0.6.5 in its place. The copy of dnspython that Seahub brings along is at 2.9.1.
